## Photorealism techniques (the "secret sauce")

- **Volumetric Lighting**: Uses a Volume Scatter node to simulate humidity or fog, creating visible light rays and softening the transition between shadow and light.
- **Micro-roughness variations**: Using noise texture maps to drive roughness values prevents surfaces from looking perfect, adding life to floor and wall materials.
- **AgX Color Transform**: Replaces Filmic to provide better highlight rolloff and more realistic color saturation in high-contrast scenes.

## Common mistakes the creator calls out

- "Don't use pure black for shadows" — Using 0.0 intensity in shadows creates unrealistic, 'flat' results; always add a tiny bit of ambient light.
